pn: Sodhana. The elder brother of Kapila, who later became Kapilamaccha (q.v.). His mother was Sādhinī and his sister Tāpanā. He entered the Saṅgha with Kapila, in the time of Kassapa Buddha, and lived in the forest, engaged in meditation, attaining Arahant-ship soon after. Dhp-a.iv.37; Snp-a.i.305f.
